source.title: GOAL Athletics .shop Migration — renovation gate, website rebrand, APLIIQ catalog & email
source.body:
> **DOMAIN-CUTOVER WARNING:** Netlify documentation states that adding a custom domain can set it as the site's primary domain by default. Before clicking the final confirmation, inspect and document the current primary domain, understand whether it will flip automatically, and only proceed when authorized and with rollback ready. It is not safe to assume the domain can be added invisibly as a non-primary staging domain. Preserve existing mailbox MX/TXT records and machine endpoints.

# GOAL Athletics → goalathletics.shop — migration and apparel rebrand execution

**Owner-approved direction (2026-10-12):** Rebrand GOOOL Athletics as GOAL Athletics, with The Goal Collective as the lifestyle division. New GoDaddy domain `goalathletics.shop`. Keep existing Netlify site, GitHub source, Stripe, Supabase, Resend, APLIIQ fulfillment and customer/order history. **Do not rebuild the store**. No live cutover or supplier-order submission until gates pass.

**Existing verified references:**
- Netlify project: `goool-shop`, production domain presently `goool.shop`.
- GitHub repo: `gdove90/portugoool-site`; approved-logo draft [PR #22](https://github.com/gdove90/portugoool-site/pull/22) is not merged.
- Gate code: `src/middleware.ts`, `src/components/Gate.tsx`, `src/app/gate/page.tsx`. Production `PREVIEW_KEY` presence is verified in Netlify and unauthenticated catalog routes redirect to the gate. PR #27 stages fail-closed behavior and customer-service exceptions; it is not deployed to production.
- Product source `src/lib/products.ts`; showroom `src/v84/catalog-data.ts`; APLIIQ signed callback `src/app/api/apliiq-fulfillment/route.ts`; checkout `src/app/api/checkout/route.ts`.
- Email sender `src/lib/email.ts` hardcodes `hello@goool.shop`; metadata and domain fallbacks in `src/lib/seo.ts`, `src/v84/brand-metadata.ts`, `src/app/layout.tsx`; redirects in `src/middleware.ts` and `netlify.toml`.
- Current approved artwork stored under user brand asset Library; traced wordmark/Halo #2 are **not** automatically manufacturer-certified.

## P0 — Baseline / backups / gate (do first, before changing live domain)
- [x] Document published deployment ID, main Git SHA, active DNS, current cert, all paid/unshipped orders, open APLIIQ jobs, and source of website product/artwork URLs.
- [x] Back up Supabase relevant tables, products, variants, supplier ID mappings, orders, refunds, checkout and fulfillment/email logs; snapshot env variable **names/scopes only**. Never write secrets to issue/commit.
- [ ] Validate and **prove** renovation gate behavior as an unauthenticated browser and with authorized preview access, on desktop and mobile. Check Netlify production `PREVIEW_KEY` presence with admin; verify newsletter signup.
- [ ] Preserve exceptions for `/api/stripe-webhook`, `/api/apliiq-fulfillment`, `/api/fulfillment-ops`, maintenance jobs, `/print/*`, customer `/track-order`, `/success`, policy and unsubscribe endpoints. Do not leak preview secret.
- [ ] Replace public gate copy/visible art with GOAL Athletics identity **only after approving accurate artwork**, keep marketing list functioning, public closed/owner access works.

## P0 — Domain / DNS / email, staged without primary switch
- [ ] Confirm GoDaddy ownership and registration completion of **goalathletics.shop** (NOT goalathletics.com).
- [ ] In **existing** Netlify site: add `goalathletics.shop` (including www if needed); choose external GoDaddy DNS and capture Netlify's exact requested DNS values. No unnecessary new Netlify project, no forced nameserver switch.
- [ ] In GoDaddy: record existing zone, add correct domain records exactly as instructed by Netlify; preserve MX/TXT email records; verify SSL and old host accessibility.
- [ ] Test new domain's homepage, preview gate, deep links, assets and HTTPS; only then plan primary-domain switch.
- [ ] Set up `hello@goalathletics.shop` in the **current** mail workspace (verify provider), DKIM/SPF/DMARC/MX and mailbox send/receive. Preserve `hello@goool.shop` as active incoming alias/forwarder for at least 6–12 months.
- [ ] Add new sender domain to Resend, verify, test transactional receipts/return/shipment emails; update Mailchimp/audience service, reply-to and automations only after verification.
- [ ] Inventory Meta Pixel/CAPI, GA4, Search Console, Search/Ads, social bio, email signatures, QR codes and marketing links for cutover.

## P1 — Precise brand asset governance
- [x] Reuse exact approved V1.2 twin-slash path coordinates; never invent lightning symbol.
- [ ] GOAL Athletics wordmark = approved italic/angular crossbar-free-A GOAL with ATHLETICS; source font **unidentified**. Preserve custom outline master, no substitute “official font”.
- [ ] Required horizontal lockup: V1.2 strike + **visible vertical divider** + official wordmark. Use validated file-level tests, visual QA.
- [ ] Halo #1 = open ring + strike; Halo #2 = circular text `GOAL ATHLETICS` / `PERFORMANCE LIVES HERE` + strike. Must retain every letter at actual intended print size; embargo microtext for too-small embroidery.
- [ ] The Goal Collective: separate Motion Thread symbol; women's **primary interlocking TGC**, women's secondary thin TGC, men's heavier TGC. Independent visual family with shared brand parent.
- [ ] Retire visibly GOOOL-spelled art from **active new product designs**; archive originals and preserve old print URLs/order associations. No SVG trace labeled production-approved until geometry, license/ownership and supplier sizing are validated.

## P1 — Catalog / supplier migration (clone, don't overwrite outstanding jobs)
- [ ] Build a SKU-level spreadsheet: site product UUID, slug, variants/colors/sizes, product blanks, APLIIQ product/design/art IDs, decoration areas, vendor specs, existing supplier status, and pricing.
- [ ] Identify all retired/unsellable SKUs and GOOOL visual references, old images/OG/social art, print-only files and variants. Do not delete order history or old image assets referenced by orders.
- [ ] On **APLIIQ**: freeze editing of designs used by paid/unfulfilled orders. Clone old active garments/designs into new GOAL versions; map new supplier design/variant IDs to catalog only after art validation.
- [ ] For each product/placement: verify blank/style/color/size, exact physical print bounding box, line and embroidery minima, 300-DPI or product-specific image requirements, neck label/embroidery restrictions, supplier preview, cost and sample approval.
- [ ] Prepare each new artwork file from exact master, not failed screenshot trace. Do not place unapproved Halo #2 or wordmark microtext into embroidery.
- [ ] Create proof mockups for existing approved garment silhouettes, preserve consistent neutral studio backdrop: product-only front, back only when graphic, then three consistent model views and one detail.
- [ ] Keep prices and checkout product identities unchanged until approved; new SKU mapping in staged code with idempotent fulfillment logic and rollback support.
- [ ] Plan new GOAL Athletics performance SKUs and The Goal Collective lifestyle SKUs separately. Do not publish new SKUs without available production source.

## P1 — Website comprehensive rebrand preview
- [x] Work from a new feature branch based on current main; reconcile PR #22 safely, preserving its verified vectors and divider.
- [x] Create componentized brand system and targeted replacements in header, footer, nav, menu, about, SEO, policy copy and accessible labels. Do NOT globally replace internal event keys, historical slugs or order metadata.
- [ ] Replace favicon, home/collection/OG/social previews, alt copy, visual panels and product images. Use new GOAL imagery; remove live public displays of the old three-O wordmark.
- [x] Add distinct `The Goal Collective` storefront entry and mobile nav, mens/womens lifestyle sections; performance remains GOAL Athletics.
- [x] Preserve existing `/shop/...` slug paths initially; design old→new slug redirects later, if needed.
- [ ] Update page metadata, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`, canonicals, sitemap, robots, JSON-LD, application links, emails, social links and search consoles **as one coordinated release**.
- [x] Until the legal rename is actually effective, keep the **registered legal entity name** accurate in seller/contracts/policies even if visible GOAL Athletics brand changes.

## P0 — Customer operations / URL migration
- [ ] Verify old `goool.shop` and `portugoool.com` URLs; plan path-preserving 301 only for customer routes and after new domain passes all checks.
- [ ] Do NOT redirect supplier `/print/*` files, Stripe/Apliiq POST webhooks or order tracking callbacks blindly. Keep old hosts serving required machine endpoints until suppliers migrate and tests prove they work.
- [ ] Maintain active Stripe endpoints/signature verification, Netlify scheduled workers, order confirmation queues, idempotency keys and Meta tracking.
- [ ] Test sandbox Stripe checkout, supplier callbacks (test signatures), shipment/tracking, returns/customer emails, failure/retry behavior. No real purchase without owner approval.
- [ ] Confirm existing orders remain fulfillable under legacy IDs.

## P0 — Release gates / rollback
- [ ] Build/lint/typecheck/tests pass, including GOAL vector integrity checks. Take screenshots 320px/390px/768px/1440px both themes where applicable.
- [ ] Test publicly gated store, authenticated preview, new domain SSL, newsletter, legal/contact, order tracking and `/print/*`; test redirects with zero loops.
- [ ] Inspect each active SKU physically in website/product staging for old GOOOL letters in images, labels, headers and alt copy.
- [ ] Approve small-batch sample prints/stitch-outs for every decoration method and placement before activating corresponding new products.
- [ ] Gate approvals: **(1) exact domain DNS, (2) master logos, (3) APLIIQ sample/SKU mapping, (4) new email, (5) full e2e commerce tests, (6) legal name/trademark clearance for business usage.**
- [ ] Stage release and get owner review. Only after explicit approval change Netlify primary domain and publish; keep old site host redirect/compatibility; monitor 404s, webhook errors, APLIIQ failures, abandoned checkout and email deliverability for 48–72h.
- [x] Publish rollback runbook: previous deploy/branch SHA, domain rollback, sender reversion, supplier mapping reversion; rollback immediately if payments or fulfillment fail.

## Execution contract for Codex
1. Do the P0 **read-only audit and report first**, then implement safe code changes on a separate branch/PR and deploy previews, not production.
2. Keep a P0/P1 table of current status, owner/agent, evidence and blockers. Update this issue as tasks finish; never check a task from assumption.
3. Ask for explicit user approval before irreversible DNS changes, modifying live supplier products, purchasing anything, sending customers email, launching live checkout or production deploy.
4. Flag missing APLIIQ login/account-level permissions and GoDaddy domain editor access, since repo access alone cannot modify those.
5. Never invent production-ready art or substitute fonts. Existing approved art library is reference unless manufacturer-certified.
6. **No action is complete without verification evidence**.

## Verified execution update — 12 October 2026

Completed checkboxes above mean the audited or staged work is verified; **no production migration is approved or published**.

- Draft [PR #27](https://github.com/gdove90/portugoool-site/pull/27), branch `codex/goal-athletics-shop-migration`, starts at main `24903a4` and preserves PR #22 assets. [Audit and rollback runbook](https://github.com/gdove90/portugoool-site/blob/codex/goal-athletics-shop-migration/docs/migration/README.md).
- Production remains `goool.shop`, deploy `6acd5bf24cad2bdcce632bf3`. Contact, Support, FAQ and Shipping & Returns currently redirect to the production gate; the fix is staged. Catalog closure is verified. Production `/print/...` works on goool.shop but redirects from portugoool.com, so cross-host exceptions remain an open release check.
- Backups: verified Git bundle with 63 refs; all 11 public Supabase tables / 134 rows exported locally and count-checked; 160-column schema inventory; daily physical backup at 08:50:13 UTC; sole private storage bucket has 0 objects. Customer data and backup files remain local, outside GitHub. No restore rehearsal claimed.
- Product inventory workbook: 68 repository products / 288 variants / 113 mapped variants / 25 design IDs; live census of 45 grouped APLIIQ products. 108 mapped variants match live IDs; design 6112026 (five legacy variants) is not matched. Database has 64 product rows versus 68 repository records. Full decoration/art IDs, dimensions, costs and new manufacturing approvals are still incomplete, so the broad inventory/manufacturing checkboxes remain open.
- Read-only order audit found two live paid/unfulfilled orders, one still needing reconciliation with no supplier ID. References are in the private local audit. Existing designs are untouched; do not automatically resubmit or clone paid jobs.
- Passing checks: build/lint/typecheck, 10 migration suites, 6 vector proofs, 4 preview-worker isolation cases, 27 v84 regression checks, admin 9, upload 5, maintenance 6, backend 44, shipment 9, Meta 10 + 9, SEO 4, local HTTP 6, operator status 12, 185 release route/link/asset checks and all nine legacy product galleries.
- Test blockers: old product-imagery harness does not include current gallery dependencies; legacy file-store integration fixtures lack Supabase email-queue storage (37 pass / 7 fail before stopping; fulfillment gaps 32 pass / 2 fail). Full provider/email and restore tests require an isolated fixture. These are not counted as passes.
- All new product/kit galleries are held out of the design preview pending verified art; no speculative mockup is labeled manufacturing-approved. The exact strike/divider are retained; reconstructed wordmark/Halo and TGC families still need manufacturing master/proof approval.
- New domain remains GoDaddy parked. Current mail provider is Google Workspace. No new sender is enabled. DNS addition/primary switch, Workspace/Resend verification, supplier submissions, product release and announcements remain approval/source/access gates.

comments.author: gdove90
comments.text:
### POD-only sourcing policy — enforced for both GOAL brands (2026-10-13)

**Owner decision:** GOAL Athletics and The Goal Collective are *strict print-on-demand*. NO bulk inventory, presale production batches, manufacturer minimum orders, or single-piece sample-only providers as live fulfillment vendors. Products must be produced **after each customer sale**, one unit/order at a time, and **direct-shipped** to the customer without holding inventory. Prefer verified integration/API for the existing custom Next.js storefront; hold all catalog activation until true order automation, sample approval, artwork approval, shipping and financial economics pass.

**Critical supplier correction:** DTLA Print's [official FAQ](https://www.dtlaprint.com/about/) states explicitly: *"At the moment we offer bulk fulfillment for pre-sale models and do not offer print on demand services."* Its one-piece decoration minimum for DTG/transfers/embroidery DOES NOT prove ongoing per-order POD. Therefore **all 75 DTLA candidate SKUs are REFERENCE ONLY**, not eligible for GOAL production purchase/routing as-is. If exact blanks are obtainable through APLIIQ/Printful/Printify or another true POD provider, create a new separately verified provider-specific SKU before activation. Never convert old DTLA shortlist into live order instructions.

**Documented alternatives and constraints:**
- [Printful custom jerseys](https://www.printful.com/custom-jerseys): per-order production, no MOQ, provider fulfillment; [AOP recycled sports jersey #105](https://www.printful.com/custom/mens/all/all-over-print-recycled-unisex-sports-jersey) offers a breathable sublimated sports-jersey baseline. [AOP athletic shorts #305](https://www.printful.com/custom/collections/sportswear/all-over-print-unisex-athletic-shorts), [track jacket #1410](https://www.printful.com/custom/mens/jackets/all-over-print-recycled-unisex-track-jacket), and [water-resistant men's windbreaker](https://www.printful.com/custom/products/all/all-over-print-mens-windbreaker) are per-order product candidates. Supplier supports [custom API/manual store](https://help.printful.com/hc/en-us/articles/50262225690257-How-do-I-create-and-use-a-manual-order-API-store), but a custom GOAL integration has **not** been built or tested yet.
- [Signature Locker](https://signaturelocker.com/) advertises true on-demand soccer, lacrosse and field-hockey uniform team stores, shipping to individual athletes, with no MOQ. However GOAL-branded custom storefront/API integration is **unverified**, so do NOT publish from their catalog yet.
- Rise Uniform/Ninja Print show one-piece sublimated uniform manufacturing, but are **on hold** until recurring individual orders + customer-direct fulfillment and GOAL-site integration are demonstrated. One sample is insufficient.
- Printify is broadly POD; its [jersey page](https://printify.com/custom-jerseys/) says soccer uses jersey-style T-shirts, not proven traditional pro soccer cut. Keep true match-kit claims on hold.

**Mandatory full match kit gate:** Jersey + shorts + socks (plus goalkeeper, field hockey, volleyball and lacrosse-specific items as applicable) all need separate POD eligibility and fit/sport tests. If any component cannot be fulfilled individually per sale, **the full kit stays OFF the catalog**.

**Updated Excel decision book:** ChatGPT Library path `/GOAL Brand Group/Product Development/POD-Only Catalog 2026-10-13/GOAL_POD_ONLY_Sourcing_Catalog_v2_2026-10-13.xlsx`. The prior DTLA workbook is superseded (retained for research). It contains 75 frozen DTLA references, 14 documented Printful POD prospects, three provider/program eval prospects, 12 sport-kit gates and revised action plan. No production SKU is certified or published. Do not modify existing APLIIQ order IDs/design mapping or unfulfilled customer orders.

**Next work:** Verify APLIIQ SKU-level catalog, build/test isolated Printful API integration, obtain samples, and get written supplier proof of no MOQ, unit-after-sale manufacture, direct delivery, brand labeling, and tracking/returns.

**Division:** The Goal Collective = performance-inspired lifestyle, yoga, studio, gym, travel, recovery. GOAL Athletics retains true team/match competition kit identity.
